test_fuse_convbnrelu: test fusing ConvBNRelu blocks by merging convolution and batch normalization layers into a single fused module
test_fuse_model: test fusing an entire FBNet model architecture with batch normalization layers using both FX and non-FX modes
test_fuse_model_fx: test fusing a custom PyTorch module with FX symbolic tracing to merge conv and batch norm layers
test_fuse_model_customized: test fusing a custom module by registering a FUSE_LIST_GETTER to specify which submodules to fuse together
test_swap_modules: test swapping custom module types like SubConv with standard PyTorch modules using a swap mapping dictionary
